summary.tldr: Changes the Citizenship Act to expand citizenship by descent and adoption rules, restore citizenship to some people, and add a simple renunciation process for some new citizens.
what_it_does: Ensures citizenship by descent for people born outside Canada before the bill takes effect to a Canadian parent.
Extends citizenship by descent to people born outside Canada after the first generation, if a Canadian parent had a substantial connection to Canada before the child’s birth.
Allows citizenship to be granted to people born outside Canada who were adopted before the bill takes effect by a Canadian parent.
Allows citizenship to be granted to people born outside Canada who are adopted on or after the bill takes effect by a Canadian parent with a substantial connection to Canada before the adoption.
Restores citizenship to people who lost it under the former section 8 retention rules, and lets some people who gain citizenship under this bill use a simplified process to renounce it.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 5 June 2025. It amends the Citizenship Act.
